questions.question: The length of a cuboid is 10 cm. If the breath of the cuboid is half of its lengths and height of the cuboid is twice of its length, then what is the lateral surface area of the cuboid?
questions.solution:
Given: 

The length of a cuboid is 10 cm. If the breath of the cuboid in half of its lengths and height of the cuboid is twice of its length

Formula used:

The lateral surface area of a cuboid = 2 ×(l+b) × h

(l = length, b = breadth , h = height)

Calculation: 

The height of the cuboid will be 10 × 2 = 20 cm

The breath of the cuboid will be 10/2 = 5 cm

The lateral surface area of a cuboid is,

⇒ 2 × (l + b) × h = 2 ×(10 + 5) × 20

⇒ 600 cm2

∴ The correct option is 1

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

96 ÷ 3 - 24 + 16 × 8 = 36
questions.solution:

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : 8 and 3

Given equation is : 96 ÷ 3 - 24 + 16 × 8 = 36

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 96 ÷ 8 - 24 + 16 × 3 = 36

⇒ __**96 ÷ 8**__ - 24 + 16 × 3 = 36

⇒ 12 - 24 + __**16 × 3**__ = 36

⇒ __**12**__ - 24 __**+ 48**__ = 36

⇒ __**60**____** - 24**__ = 36

⇒ **36**** = 36**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2) : 24 and 3

Given equation is : 96 ÷ 3 - 24 + 16 × 8 = 36

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 96 ÷ 24 - 3 + 16 × 8 = 36

⇒ __**96 ÷ 24**__ - 3 + 16 × 8 = 36

⇒ 4 - 3 + __**16 × 8**__ = 36

⇒ __**4**__ - 3 __**+ 48**__ = 36

⇒ __**52 - 3**__ = 36

⇒ 49 ≠ 36

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 96 and 24

Given equation is : 96 ÷ 3 - 24 + 16 × 8 = 36

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 24 ÷ 3 - 96 + 16 × 8 = 36

⇒ __**24 ÷ 3**__ - 96 + 16 × 8 = 36

⇒ __**8**__ - 96 __**+ 128**__ = 36

⇒ __**136**____** - 96**__ = 36

⇒ 40 ≠ 36

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : 8 and 16

Given equation is : 96 ÷ 3 - 24 + 16 × 8 = 36

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 96 ÷ 3 - 24 + 8 × 16 = 36

⇒ __**96 ÷ 3**__ - 24 + 8 × 16 = 36

⇒ 32 - 24 + __**8 × 16**__ = 36

⇒ __**32**__ - 24 __**+ 128**__ = 36

⇒ __**160**____** - 24**__ = 36

⇒ 136 ≠ 36

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"8 and 3".**

questions.question: Article 40 of the Indian constitution, "Organisation of village panchayats", is a _______.

• Articles 36-51 of Part-IV of the Indian Constitution deals with Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP). 
 
• They are borrowed from the Constitution of Ireland. 
 
• DPSPs are non-justiciable i.e non-enforceable in the court of law.
 
• They act as directives to the government to create any law.
 
• They act as the ‘instrument of instructions’.

• Fundamental duties:-

 
 
• ​These are a set of moral obligations that are mentioned in the Constitution of India.
 
• They were added by the 42nd Amendment Act in 1976.
 
• These duties are not enforceable by law but are expected to be followed by every citizen as a means of promoting a spirit of patriotism and upholding the ideals of the Constitution.
 
 
 
• Fundamental Rights:-
 
 
• FRs are known as the base of the Indian constitution & mentioned in Part III of the constitution.
 
• They prohibit unreasonable interference of the state & prevent its executive & legislature to become authoritarian, hence putting due limitations on state power.
 
 
 
• Legal right:-
 
 
• It is an interest accepted and protected by law.
 
• It is a claim that a person has against another person or against the state. Legal rights can be enforced through the courts.

questions.question: The disease-causing microbes are called _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Pathogens**.

__
 
• **The disease-causing microbes are called pathogens. **
 
• Pathogens can be viruses, bacteria, fungi, protozoa, or helminths (worms).
 
• They can cause a wide range of diseases, from mild to severe, and can be transmitted in a variety of ways, including through direct contact, contaminated food or water, or insect bites. 
 
• Examples of common diseases caused by different types of pathogens:
 
 
• **Viruses**: COVID-19, influenza, measles, mumps, rubella, HIV/AIDS, herpes, rabies
 
• **Bacteria**: Strep throat, pneumonia, tuberculosis, cholera, salmonellosis, Lyme disease
 
• **Fungi**: Athlete's foot, ringworm, candidiasis, histoplasmosis, coccidioidomycosis
 
• **Protozoa**: Malaria, toxoplasmosis, giardia, amoebiasis
 
• **Helminths**: Ascariasis, hookworm, tapeworm, trichinosis

• **Decomposers:-**

 
 
• These are organisms that break down dead or decaying organisms and organic matter.
 
• They play a vital role in ecosystems by recycling nutrients and making them available to other organisms.
 
• Decomposers can be found in all environments, from soil and water to forests and deserts.
 
 
 
• **Toxin:-**
 
 
• It is a poisonous substance produced within living cells or organisms.
 
 
 
• **Antibodies:-**
 
 
• It is also known as immunoglobulins, are proteins produced by the immune system in response to infection.
 
• They are an important part of the body's defense system as they work to destroy disease-causing organisms (such as viruses or bacteria) and block them from infecting human cells.

• **These are substances that are introduced between two surfaces in contact in order to reduce friction. (Hence option 4 is correct)**

• This reduces the amount of heat generated and the wear and tear on the surfaces. 
 
• There are many different types of lubricants, including:

• Greases
 
• Solids, such as graphite and molybdenum disulfide

• **These are substances that can flow easily and continuously deform under an applied shear stress, or external force. **

• **It is a material or object that produces a magnetic field. **

questions.question: Which among the following type of unemployment is also known as the real wage unemployment?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**classical**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

**Real wage unemployment:-**

 
• **It is a type of classical unemployment. (Hence option 1 is correct)**
 
• It occurs when the real wage is set above the equilibrium real wage.
 
• **The equilibrium real wage is the wage that is consistent with full employment, meaning that everyone who wants to work at the prevailing wage rate can find a job.**
 
• Real wage unemployment can be caused by a number of factors, including:
 
 
• **Minimum wage laws:** Minimum wage laws set a legal minimum wage that employers must pay their workers. If the minimum wage is set above the equilibrium real wage, it can lead to real wage unemployment.
 
• **Collective bargaining agreements:** Collective bargaining agreements are contracts between unions and employers that set wages and other working conditions. If a union negotiates a wage rate that is above the equilibrium real wage, it can lead to real wage unemployment.
 
• **Efficiency wages:** Some firms may choose to pay their workers wages above the equilibrium real wage in order to boost worker productivity and morale. However, if all firms do this, it can lead to real wage unemployment.
